jei.lararium.heart: Build an enclosed space above the heart and measure with a Tuning Fork. A compact nook wakes a Keeper; a tall shaft a Breather; a two-high passage around a pillar a Listener; a broad low room a Shelter. An amethyst shard supplies 32 breaths. Feed string to weave Hollow Thread. A doorway may be sealed with a walkable Threshold Veil.
jei.lararium.hook: A sidegrade made from Ostentum’s Amethyst Hook. Equip in the Curios hook slot and use Fundamentum’s hook controls. 18-block reach, two hooks, 2.5 seconds of air anchoring at maximum range. Copper Perches give ordinary hooks a precise target.
jei.lararium.brooch: Equip in a Curios charm slot. Falling more than five blocks triggers five seconds of Slow Falling, spending one of 16 catches. The 20-second cooldown belongs to the wearer and survives swapping charms. Recharge by crafting the brooch with an amethyst shard.
jei.lararium.keeper: A Keeper can remember a favourite item type. Hold the Tuning Fork in your main hand and a sample in your off hand, then sneak-use the Keeper. The sample is kept. Favourite offerings are collected first and produce one second of redstone output through the unmarked faces. Other offerings are still accepted. Sneak-use with an empty off hand to forget. Each successful collection still costs one breath.

jei.lararium.answer: Teach a Listener eight beats. Sneak-use your fork with Hollow Thread in your off hand to switch between repeating and answering calls. A new redstone signal at the marked face plays one phrase for one breath. Try wiring in a button or a Keeper’s favourite greeting.
